profile_text.body:
Toyota Research Institute is a for-profit research organization founded in 2015 and headquartered in Los Altos, California. Its website describes it as working toward a future in which Toyota products, enabled by TRI technology, improve quality of life for individuals and society. The company also describes its own workplace as a start-up environment staffed by people who enjoy solving difficult problems, with the financial backing to pursue its goals.

The site frames TRI's technology as something that reaches the public through Toyota products rather than as standalone offerings, and no individual AI products from the company are listed in the available material. The company's stated aim is the improvement of quality of life for individuals and society through that product integration.

Litigation involving the company is recorded in California, where 281 cases are noted. No MCP servers are listed for the company.
